meta.description: NewFarmer helps small farmers care for animals, plan crops for their climate and follow the 5-day weather — on computer and phone.

home.title: NewFarmer · Animals and garden planner for your climate
home.description: Care guides per animal, a planting calendar for your climate, 5-day forecast with rain in mm and a diary. Works offline. Monthly subscription.
home.heroTitle: Your animals and garden, organized for your climate
home.heroSub: Care guides, a planting calendar and a 5-day forecast for your town, on computer and phone.
home.heroAlt: NewFarmer dashboard on a computer, with animals, crops and the week's weather

animals.title: Care guides for each animal
animals.text: Feeding, vaccines and care for chickens, goats, cows and other animals.

crops.title: Planting calendar
crops.text: What to plant each month, for your climate and hemisphere.

weather.title: 5-day forecast
weather.text: Temperature and rain in mm for your town, to plan the work.

diary.title: Diary for each animal
diary.text: Log vaccines, medicine and births and see it all on the Dashboard.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.text: No signal in the field? Write it down and NewFarmer sends it later.

rules.title: Your country's rules
rules.text: Notes on what is required where you live, like declaring your animals.

one.title: Create your account
one.text: Enter your name, e-mail and town. From the town, NewFarmer works out your climate and hemisphere.

two.title: Tell us what you raise
two.text: Pick your animals and how many you have, and search the crops on your land.
two.note: You can change it later in MyFarm

three.title: Subscribe
three.text: Pay the monthly fee by card, on a secure Stripe page.

four.title: Use it every day
four.text: The Dashboard shows what to do this month, the 5-day forecast and your diary, on computer or phone.
